mapper.sql: id, parent_id, parent_ids, name, sort, code, type, remarks, longitude, latitude, del_flag
a.id, a.parent_id AS "parent.id", a.parent_ids, a.code, a.name, a.sort, a.type, a.remarks, a.longitude, a.latitude, a.del_flag, p.name AS "parent.name", p.parent_ids as "parent.parentIds"
LEFT JOIN sys_area p ON p.id = a.parent_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_area a
WHERE a.type in (1,2,3,4) and a.del_flag = #{DEL_FLAG_NORMAL} ORDER BY a.code

SELECT
FROM sys_area a
WHERE a.type in (1,2,3,4) and a.del_flag = #{DEL_FLAG_NORMAL} AND a.parent_ids LIKE #{parentIds} ORDER BY a.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_area( parent_id, parent_ids, code, name, sort, type, longitude, latitude, remarks, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{parent.id}, #{parentIds}, #{code}, #{name}, #{sort}, #{type}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{remarks}, #{delFlag} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_area SET parent_id = #{parent.id}, parent_ids = #{parentIds}, code = #{code}, name = #{name}, sort = #{sort}, type = #{type}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, remarks = #{remarks} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_area SET del_flag = #{DEL_FLAG_DELETE} WHERE id = #{id} OR parent_ids LIKE '%,'||#{id}||',%' '%,'+#{id}+',%' CONCAT('%,', #{id}, ',%')
